text:
incident-bot: PAGED @eng-oncall — p99 latency spike observed on continuous-batching path for model=streaming-text in us-west-2. SLO p99=200ms breached -> current p99 ~1200ms. severity=P1. Pager: maria
maria: taking pager, jumping into dashboards now.
aj: seeing tail jump starting ~11:29 UTC, p95 also creeping up. traces show long wait in batch queue.
kevin: any infra or deploys in last 30m?
ops-bot: no deploys. autoscaler events: minor GPU churn 11:20-11:25 but steady after.
lia: correlating with KV cache eviction spikes on contbatch nodes, eviction count +80% at 11:28.
maria: grabbing worker logs, grep for enqueue/backpressure: `grep \"enqueue\" contbatch_worker.log | tail -n 50` shows many enqueues with batch_size=64 and wait_ms 800-1500.
sam: hypothesis: padding amplification + mixed seqlen is blocking short requests behind long ones. immediate mitigation: disable batching for streaming route and reduce max_batch_size. propose commands:
```
# disable batching for streaming route
redwoodctl routes update streaming-text --set batch.enabled=false --region usw2
# reduce max batch size
redwoodctl routes update streaming-text --set batch.max_size=8 --region usw2
```

maria: rolling config change to 10% canary in us-west-2 now. pushing via infra rollout.
kevin: also flip scheduler fairness to favor small seqs: `scheduler.fairness.weight_short=2.0` — maybe lower padding amplification quickly.
tasha: enable preemptive-shed on contbatch `scheduler.preemptive_shed=true` to avoid long-seq starvation.
aj: canary at 10% applied at 11:37 UTC. metrics: p99 dropped to ~420ms, p95 ~150ms.
maria: increasing to 30% rollout. monitoring dashboards: latency tail continuing downward.
sam: good sign. continue ramp to 100% slow-roll while watching error rate. leave 10% as fallback zone.
kevin: opened follow-up ticket (INC-177888) to tune sequence bucketing, batch sizing heuristics, and KV cache eviction policy. tagging eng-runtime + eng-ml.
lia: note for postmortem: investigate KV cache TTL and eviction noise during autoscaler activity. may need sticky KV shards or warmed cache on scale events.
maria: customer impact: preliminary numbers show ~0.5% increase in 5xx/timeouts at peak window, few customers reported degraded responses, no customer-facing incident page yet. CS notified.
tasha: adding runbook action: on future spikes, first step toggle `batch.enabled=false` for streaming routes before full node-level mitigations.
aj: handing off monitoring and postmortem ownership to me for next shift. I've captured runbook steps + commands.
maria: thanks — I'll keep the incident doc updated with logs and timeline. closing pager now but keeping channel open for followups. :thumbsup:
incident-bot: Pager cleared, incident remains active for postmortem tracking (INC-177888).
